transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our routine referral huddle. As you know, we have one expedited kidney-transplant evaluation board opening next week, and four medically plausible candidates — Ash, Birch, Cedar, and Delta — are under consideration. Before I sign off on the agenda, I need transplant medicine, infectious disease, financial counseling, and social work to report any referral-specific updates on each of these four patients. Please go ahead and share what you have so I can record the final plan.
